blocks.text: The Argentine side of Iguazu Falls

provenance.rationale: The Word Day 4 paragraph explicitly describes the guided visit to the Argentine side of the falls.

blocks.text: Day 4 · After breakfast, a guided tour of the Argentine side, reached by the Tancredo Neves Bridge over the Iguazu River. Here you walk directly above and below the falls: the Upper Circuit, a walk of about 1,300 metres on see-through metal walkways, takes you along the top of the falls, feeling their power very close; a small train then takes you to the platforms over the Devil’s Throat, a spectacle you could watch for hours. For hiking fans, the Lower Circuit offers a close-up experience of the falls and, weather permitting, the crossing to San Martín Island.
